title: Edit the exception schedule
summary: Change the details of an existing exception schedule.

steps.title: Menu → Business Setup → Exception Schedules
steps.details: Holidays, one-off or recurring closures, or days with different hours. They override the regular hours.

steps.title: Choose the exception schedule
steps.details: Tap it in the list to see its details.

steps.title: Date
steps.details: The day of the holiday or closure.

steps.title: Dates
steps.details: For a one-off exception, you can mark several days.

steps.title: Branch
steps.details: Leave «All branches» to apply it to the whole clinic.

steps.title: Is it open?
steps.details: Open with different hours, or closed.

steps.title: From
steps.details: Leave both times empty to close all day; with a range only that stretch is closed.
